P.name: Death in Lavender
P.title: Template:Data Bel'Veth/Death in Lavender
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Death in Lavender|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Bel'Veth |skill = I |icon = false |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Bel'Veth}} has no attack speed cap, but her {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}} does not grow by {{sti|xp|leveling up}}. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Bel'Veth''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, she generates a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Lavender''. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Lavender:}} For each stack, '''Bel'Veth''' gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth''' is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}}. Her {{as|attack speed}} does not increase through [[Champion statistic#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]]. |description2 = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' {{tip|ability}} casts grant her {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts. |icon3 = Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png |description3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or large {{tip|minion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she generates a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Lavender''. Large minions and monsters generate 1 stack, champions and epic monsters generate 2 stacks.

{{sbc|Lavender:}} For each stack, '''Bel'Veth''' gains {{as|{{pplevel|0.1; then +0.05*x for 4; then +0.1*x for 5; then +0.15*x|1 to 18|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}. |cost = |costtype = |cooldown = |range = |effect radius= |cast time = |targeting = Passive |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = |spelleffects = |spellshield = |parry = |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |callforhelp = |notes = * '''Bel'Veth's''' ''attack speed cap'' is increased to {{fd|9999.0}}, however this value is already way beyond the technical limit for attack speed. * ''Death in Lavender's'' {{tip|takedown}} effect will not trigger against monsters if they were slain by an enemy. }}

R.name: Endless Banquet
R.title: Template:Data Bel'Veth/Endless Banquet
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Endless Banquet|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Bel'Veth |skill = R |icon = false |description = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every attack {{tip|on-hit}} against the marked target deals {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} and generates a stack of ''Endless Banquet'' that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 8 stacks against epic {{tip|monsters}}. |leveling = {{st|Bonus True Damage|{{ap|2 to 6}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' AD)}}}} {{st|Maximum Monster Damage|{{ap|2*8 to 6*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}} |description2 = {{sbc|Passive:}} When '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} while alive, a ''Void Coral'' is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, the pit {{ui|Rift Herald}}, and {{ui|Voidgrub|Voidgrubs}} (once per spawn group) spawn an ''Enhanced Void Coral''. |description3 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target ''Void Coral'' to consume it over the cast time, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by {{pp|type=seconds elapsed|key=%|25;42;69;96|0 to 0.75|changedisplay=true}} for the duration. She then creates an explosion at the location to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies within, capped at {{as|1500|true damage}} versus monsters, and assumes her {{sbc|True Form}} for {{pp|45;90;infinite|0;40;80|type=[[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|link=]] ''Lavender'' stacks}} seconds.
'''Bel'Veth''' consumes all existing ''Void Corals'' at once, generating a stack of ''{{ai|Death in Lavender|Bel'Veth|Lavender}}'' for each one consumed. |leveling3 = {{st|True Damage|{{ap|150 to 250}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}} {{as|(+ 20% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}} |icon4 = Bel'Veth Endless Banquet.png |description4 = {{sbc|True Form:}} '''Bel'Veth''' evolves into a monster, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}}, increased size, as well as increased {{as|'''total''' attack speed}}. ''{{ai|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' can {{tip|dash}} through [[terrain]]. Consuming a ''Void Coral'' {{tt|refreshes|See notes}} the duration of {{sbc|True Form}} and {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Bel'Veth'''.

{{sbc|Enhanced Void Coral Bonus:}} {{sbc|True Form}} is empowered to causes ''Void Remora'' to spawn from allied and enemy {{tip|minions}} that die nearby. |leveling4 = {{st|Bonus Health|{{ap|100 to 400}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}} {{st|Bonus Attack Range|{{ap|25 to 125}}}} {{st|Increased Size|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}} {{st|Increased Total Attack Speed|{{ap|6 to 20}}%}} {{st|Heal|{{ap|100 to 400}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}} |description5 = ''A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability. The passive {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} is affected by the {{tip|on-hit}} modifier of {{ai|Royal Maelstrom|Bel'Veth}}. See [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Pets]] for details about Void Remora and Void Corals.'' |cost = |costtype = |cooldown = 1 |range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|450|Void Coral targeting radius}} |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|500|Slow and explosion radius}} |cast time = 1 |queue time = {{fd|0.35}} |targeting = Unit |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = True |spelleffects = special |spellshield = true |parry = |projectile = |grounded = True |knockdown = special |callforhelp = |notes = * Applies {{tip|proc damage}} on the bonus true damage and deals {{tip|area damage}} on the explosion. * ''Endless Banquet's'' {{tip|takedown}} effect will not trigger against monsters if they were slain by an enemy. * ''Endless Banquet's'' true damage based on the target's missing health is calculated ''before'' the base damage is dealt. * ''True Form's'' duration is displayed in '''Bel'Veth's''' resource bar, in seconds. ** The resource bar's color is white. It is purple when '''Bel'Veth''' has the enhanced ''Void Coral'' bonus. * '''Bel'Veth's''' ''True Form'' at 80 {{ai|I|Bel'Veth|Lavender}} stacks will last indefinitely, but is still lost upon death. * '''Bel'Veth''' will consume all existing ''Void Corals'' at once, therefore she is able to acquire the enhanced effects of ''True Form'' even if she does not physically consume an enhanced ''Void Coral''. * The ''Void Coral'' that '''Bel'Veth''' consumes herself will not expire in the process of her doing so. * '''Bel'Veth''' will consume all other ''Void Corals'' upon consumption regardless of range. * Ranking up ''Endless Banquet'' will update the bonuses dynamically; if '''Bel'Veth''' has ''True Form'' upon the level-up, she will receive the upgraded stats. * '''Bel'Veth''' gains the '''bonus''' health and heal from ''Endless Banquet'' at the start of the cast time. * '''Bel'Veth''' will be able to consume the target ''Void Coral'' even if her dash is interrupted. ** She dashes at the start of the cast time. * A ''Void Coral'' will '''not''' spawn when scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a summoned {{ui|Rift Herald}}. {{Effect at cast time start}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Bel'Veth''' is in cast time: ** Movement summoner spells can be buffered to cast after the cast time completes if permitted. ** She is locked out of movement and attack actions for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the cast time completes and no buffering of them is permitted for the entirety of her lockout. {{ct|cast=false|move=false|attack=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false,true,false|interrupts=revival-false}} |blurbicon = Bel'Veth Endless Banquet.png |blurb = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} and generates a {{tip|stack}} that increases this damage against the same target. Taking down {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, the pit {{ui|Rift Herald}}, or a {{ui|Voidgrub}} spawns an ''Enhance Void Coral''. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Bel'Veth}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target ''Void Coral'', gradually {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies before violently exploding, dealing {{as|true damage}} based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}} and assuming her {{sbc|True Form}} for a while. {{sbc|True Form's}} duration increases as '''Bel'Veth''' gains stacks of {{ai|Death in Lavender|Bel'Veth|''Lavender''}}, eventually lasting until death. |blurb4 = {{sbc|True Form:}} '''Bel'Veth''' gains bonus {{sti|{{as|health}}}}, {{sti|attack range}}, and increased {{as|'''total''' attack speed}}. During this time, ''{{ai|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' can {{tip|dash}} through terrain. Consuming more ''Void Corals'' renews the form's duration and {{sti|heal|{{as|heals her|heal}}}} instead.
